_comment: Per-stage weighting profiles for the Godmode decision engine. Weights for each stage sum to 1.0. Adjust as the calibration data accumulates.

mvp-speed._description: User wants to ship fast. Optimizes for learning curve, DX, community size, and cost. Performance/maturity matter less than time-to-first-user.

production-scale._description: User is going to real users, real traffic, real money. Optimizes for maturity, performance, observability, and long-term maintainability.

research-experimental._description: User is exploring, prototyping novel ideas. Optimizes for innovation, flexibility, performance ceiling, and DX. Maturity matters least.

enterprise-compliance._description: User is in a regulated environment (finance, healthcare, gov). Optimizes for maturity, vendor support, security, and audit-ability.
